# Draft:Battle of Sebennytos (641)

The Battle of Sebennytos or Samannoud (Arabic: سمنود) was a significant, albeit minor, Byzantine victory over Rashidun forces during the Arab conquest of Egypt. It occurred as Rashidun forces under Amr ibn al-As moved to secure the Nile Delta against remaining Byzantine resistance following the surrender & fall of the Fortress of babylon.
